factual_errors: Sec. 5.3, p. 10: 'In the embeddings no genuine split has an error above 0.53'. Table 16 reports 95% ranges with upper bounds up to 0.532, which implies that some splits exceed 0.53. The value is the maximum of the 95% upper bounds (build_assets.py: emb_upper = max of interval95 upper bounds), not the maximum over splits. The supportable statement is that no embedding split exceeds 1.
